summary: Vistra Corp. filed an 8-K reporting completion on October 30, 2026 of its previously announced acquisition of 100% of the LLC interests in Q-Generation, LLC from Q-Generation Holdings, LLC, followed by a merger of Vistra subsidiary TSVME LLC into Hamilton Holdings II, LLC, which survived as a wholly owned subsidiary. Total consideration was approximately $2.2 billion in cash, net of working capital and acquired-cash adjustments, plus assumed debt and related items; no per-share price or premium applies given the entity-level structure. The filing also discloses a new direct financial obligation, unregistered equity sales and Regulation FD materials; integration and financing terms are the watch items.
